Name: Event Lookup Locations
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[size=3][b]What exactly does this mod do:[/b][/size]
[size=2]It's a simple mod fixing location names added by other mods when they are displayed in Event Lookup. For example:[/size]
[size=2]Custom_HighlandsCavern to Highlands Cavern[/size]

[b][size=3]Config:[/size][/b]
[i]Hide unreachable locations [default: true][/i] - If enabled hides events that start at unreachable maps and starts showing them as they become closer to unlock.
[i]Hide RSV Events [default: false][/i] - If enabled hides events happening at Ridgeside Village (special events and events in the Pelican Town still show up).

[size=3][b]Why did I make this mod?
[/b][/size]I wanted to make my event list more clean and easier to read. Some of the map names were quite confusing and didn't hint at what it might actually be. Some mods were already included in the Event Lookup (like RSV and partially SVE) and some mod authors add their own patches (East Scarp), but many remain unchanged.
